summary: Nothing capped how many photo decodes ran at once in one server instance; several 50 MP photos finalised together (~200 MB of pixels each) could run it out of memory.
fix: Every decode goes through a per-instance gate of 2 slots (decode-gate.ts). A decode with a free slot starts at once; the rest wait first come, first served, for up to 15 s, then finalise answers busy (503 + Retry-After, nothing refused or deleted) and the uploader's retry or the media job's next run finalises the same upload.
